RESEARCH BOUNDARY

          
What this probe can prove

        

        
      

      
The lab seed deliberately creates compatible pressures and holdings, then stops authoring. The actors share generic intent transforms, dependency-triggered rules, and invariants. It contains no written quest, dialogue tree, or selected character class.

      

        
OBSERVED
A million-cell logical field can remain mostly asleep. One player share causes Rhea to reciprocate through a generic autonomous decision, and exact replay reproduces the branch.

        
NOT YET PROVEN
That this becomes a satisfying RPG, scales to millions of active actors, creates rich novelty, or can safely compose portable human states.
